mainText: Hello, Verona! At 5 AM, here is today's balanced dish: we have overcast skies at Reddan Soccer Park and the moon is in its Third Quarter phase.

We have two big updates from the city today. First, you can now enjoy free rides on the new tri-shaw bike program through the Senior Center, which offers a great way to see the Military Ridge State Trail. Additionally, the Public Works department is currently offering rebates for residents who install rain barrels to help manage stormwater.

There is plenty to do in our community today, starting with the Verona Downtown Farmer's Market at Hometown Junction Park and Pizza and a Pitcher at the Wisconsin Brewing Company. Looking ahead, you can check out Concerts in the Park tomorrow evening at Century School Park.
Looking at the weekly report, on July 31, an officer conducted a stop that resulted in the arrest of a woman for O W I after she was found driving with no taillights and a flat tire.

Today is the perfect day to stop by for the Peanut Butter Fudge Brownie flavor of the day. The shop is currently closed but will open at 10 AM. If you miss out, tomorrow's flavor will be Chocolate Caramel Twist.
